design.text: Double-blind, placebo-controlled trial; all patients received chloroquine plus either a single dose of tafenoquine (n=260), active control (n=129), or placebo (n=133) in a 2:1:1 fashion

citations.quote: Trial 1 (NCT01376167) was a double-blind, controlled clinical trial of 522 adults positive for *P. vivax* across 3 regions (Asia, Africa, and Latin America). All patients received chloroquine phosphate (600-mg free base on Days 1 and 2 with 300-mg free base on Day 3) to treat the acute infection in addition to either a one-time dose of KRINTAFEL (two 150-mg tablets) on Day 1 or Day 2 (n = 260), an active control (n = 129), or placebo (n = 133) in a 2:1:1 fashion.

population.text: Adults positive for P. vivax malaria (mean age 35, range 16 to 79 years), receiving chloroquine for the acute infection; G6PD-deficient patients excluded

citations.quote: Patients included in the trial had a mean age of 35 (range: 16 to 79 years), were 75% male and from the following regions: 70% Latin America (Brazil and Peru), 19% Southeast (SE) Asia (Thailand, Cambodia, and the Philippines), and 11% Afri
Due to the risk of hemolytic anemia, patients were excluded from the trial if they had a G6PD enzyme activity level <70% of the site median value for G6PD normals (8.2 IU/gHb).
The primary efficacy endpoint used in Phase 2b and Phase 3 studies (TAF112582 Part 1 and Part 2) was recurrence-free efficacy at six months postdosing.

target_moa.text: Tafenoquine is an 8-aminoquinoline antimalarial that eradicates P. vivax liver hypnozoites (dormant liver stage), preventing relapse of malaria; exact mechanism is not known

Tafenoquine (TQ), KRINTAFEL, is an 8-aminoquinoline antimalarial drug.

key_safety.text: Common adverse reactions (≥5%): dizziness, nausea, vomiting, headache, and decreased hemoglobin. In Trial 1, dizziness 8% vs 3%, nausea 6% vs 7%, vomiting 6% vs 5%, decreased hemoglobin 5% vs 2%, headache 5% vs 7% (KRINTAFEL+chloroquine vs chloroquine). Main safety risk is hemolytic anemia in G6PD-deficient patients; asymptomatic methemoglobinemia also observed.
